A covering cap that is full on a length-two interval has hinge at least two. Any two covering caps have sum at least one there: same signs force a full cap, an opposite-sign gap also forces a full cap, and overlapping opposing cuts dominate |x-t| for any t between their thresholds. Thus a full fiber costs at least five overall, strictly above 17/4.

For proper opposing cuts, coverage and the two mass budgets force zero overlap and equal local thresholds. Their affine trace t_z gives 17/4+Σt_z² because h has vanishing affine base moments. All four trace values vanish only at the stated geometric pair. Each hinge is 17/8 and each mass is four.

At that pair each primal contact is x=0 and the dual weights must be (1/2,1/2). Proper section coarea is W for |u|=1/W. The cap and contact offset and base first moments give r_+=r_-, and the remaining zero-mass, zero-first-moment kernel is exactly the checkerboard array. This includes α=0 and all |s|≤A.

Continuous raw moments are ±17/8 and section/contact moments are zero. In the full width-equality formulation the derivative of W|u| is ±W and the equality multiplier −α17/(8W) gives continuous stationarity. The cover-weight conditions use both margins zero at x=0.
